text: Herring, cod and eel, gutted on the quay and packed in brine. Every port from Marienburg to Lothern sends it inland, and every army marches on it.
Salted Fish||A building in this settlement produces Salted Fish, a trade resource.
Rendered from the great whales of the northern seas. It lights the lamps of every city that can afford them.
Whale Oil||A building in this settlement produces Whale Oil, a trade resource.
Taken by Druchii corsairs from the sea dragons of the cold seas off Naggaroth. A cloak of it turns a blade.

Sea Dragon Hide||A building in this settlement produces Sea Dragon Hide, a trade resource.
Cane spirit from the hot coasts. Sartosa and the Vampire Coast float on it.
Rum||A building in this settlement produces Rum, a trade resource.
Golden resin washed up on the Sea of Claws shores, prized by jewellers and wizards alike.
Amber||A building in this settlement produces Amber, a trade resource.
Wheat, rye and barley from the farmland of the Old World. Bread for cities and fodder for armies.
Grain||A building in this settlement produces Grain, a trade resource.
Bretonnian destriers, Kislevite steppe horses and Arabyan coursers, bred for war.
Warhorses||A building in this settlement produces Warhorses, a trade resource.
Halfling leaf from the Moot, smoked in every tavern from Altdorf to Marienburg.
Pipeweed||A building in this settlement produces Pipeweed, a trade resource.
Printed tomes and copied scrolls from the great presses, colleges and libraries.
Books||A building in this settlement produces Books, a trade resource.
Pressed in the groves of Tilea and Estalia, shipped across the Middle Sea.
Olive Oil||A building in this settlement produces Olive Oil, a trade resource.
Woven in the lowland provinces of Cathay. It is what the Ivory Road carries west.
Silk||A building in this settlement produces Silk, a trade resource.
Leaf from the terraced hills of Cathay, steeped from Wei-Jin to Nan-Gau.
Tea||A building in this settlement produces Tea, a trade resource.
Green stone quarried in Cathay's mountains, carved into charms and statues.
Jade||A building in this settlement produces Jade, a trade resource.
Black fuel dug beside the iron seams. Every forge and furnace burns it.
Coal||A building in this settlement produces Coal, a trade resource.
Veins of silver found in mountain mines already worked for iron, gems or gold.
Silver||A building in this settlement produces Silver, a trade resource.
Meteoric iron found only deep beneath the old Dwarf holds. Nothing forged is harder.
Gromril||A building in this settlement produces Gromril, a trade resource.
Liquid metal cooked out of cinnabar in volcanic rock. Alchemists and engineers pay well for it.
Quicksilver||A building in this settlement produces Quicksilver, a trade resource.
Yellow sulphur scraped from the vents of the Dark Lands and every obsidian field.
Brimstone||A building in this settlement produces Brimstone, a trade resource.
Hashut's own metal, cast in the forges of the Chaos Dwarfs.
Brass||A building in this settlement produces Brass, a trade resource.
Saltpetre from the salt pans, ground with charcoal and sulphur by the races that know the secret.
Blackpowder||A building in this settlement produces Blackpowder, a trade resource.
The light, bright metal of the elves, found only in the rock of Ulthuan.
Ithilmar||A building in this settlement produces Ithilmar, a trade resource.
Bones from the dragon-holds of Caledor and the old dragon graveyards.
Dragon Bone||A building in this settlement produces Dragon Bone, a trade resource.
Brilliant feathers of Lustria's jungle birds and serpents, worth their weight in gold in the courts of the Old World.
Lustrian Plumes||A building in this settlement produces Lustrian Plumes, a trade resource.
A poison flower of the southern jungles, sought by assassins and Witch Elves.
Black Lotus||A building in this settlement produces Black Lotus, a trade resource.
Frankincense and myrrh from the deserts of Araby, burned in temples and tombs.
Incense||A building in this settlement produces Incense, a trade resource.
Ogre herds and hunting grounds fill the barrels. Meat keeps; armies march on it.
Salted Meat||A building in this settlement produces Salted Meat, a trade resource.
Knotted by hand in the cities of Araby, in patterns older than the Empire.
Arabyan Carpets||A building in this settlement produces Arabyan Carpets, a trade resource.
Sour rye drink of Kislev, brewed from black bread. Every stanitsa keeps a barrel.
Kvas||A building in this settlement produces Kvas, a trade resource.
Thick grey hides of the Ogre Kingdoms' rhinox herds, tough enough for armour.
Rhinox Hides||A building in this settlement produces Rhinox Hides, a trade resource.
Honey wine of the Norscan halls, drunk from horns before every raid.
Mead||A building in this settlement produces Mead, a trade resource.
Blown glass from the workshops of Tilea, Estalia, Marienburg and Lothern.
Glassware||A building in this settlement produces Glassware, a trade resource.
Fleece from the sheep that graze the Old World's uplands. Spun and woven in every town.
Wool||A building in this settlement produces Wool, a trade resource.
Fine white ware fired in the kilns of Cathay's lowland cities.
Porcelain||A building in this settlement produces Porcelain, a trade resource.
Brought up by divers on the warm coasts, and worn by every noble who can pay.
Pearls||A building in this settlement produces Pearls, a trade resource.
Wood the living trees of Athel Loren shed by their own will. It is given, never cut.
Starwood||A building in this settlement produces Starwood, a trade resource.
Feathers gathered from the mountain eyries of griffons and pegasi.

Scales of the wyverns that nest in the Badlands and the Mountains of Mourn.
